editorial.opening: A whole tile field and a moving route appear immediately.
editorial.mechanism: The lifted tile and enlarged seam support degree-two continuation; loop and boundary route are shown separately.
editorial.readability: Edge marks, a dashed seam and retained field make the local-to-global relation inspectable.
editorial.pacing: Motion is paced to measured speech, with held joins and a final route after the tile change.

editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The transition to the enlarged seam is still a cut; many abstract curves and the repeated calm voice may feel impersonal. No viewer response measured.

videos.title: Straight Lines Can Gather into a Curve #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Straight lines form a visibly curved waist with a strong original silhouette.
editorial.mechanism: A selected line maps to a top-view chord; the midpoint radius and 120-degree endpoint separation explain the waist.
editorial.readability: The revised 60-degree label clears the angle arc; the view change and equal rings are identified.
editorial.pacing: Endpoint rotation, held chord reasoning and return to the surface follow speech.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed. Homophone, number-formatting and minor inflection transcription differences were read against the intended script; no mathematical change identified. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The top view replaces rather than continuously transforms the sculpture; the half-radius result assumes elementary triangle knowledge. Surface name adds vocabulary with little everyday relevance.

editorial.opening: A turning direction and signed distance begin tracing a flower.
editorial.mechanism: Two reversals explain odd retracing; the four-cycle phase begins at zero radius so four whole petals precede four opposite petals.
editorial.readability: Separate direction arrow, point and signed-distance label support the mapping; final side-by-side comparison recalls three versus eight.
editorial.pacing: Cue overruns were repaired; the ending now draws a comparison instead of holding a single unchanged flower.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. All full ASR transcripts reviewed. Homophone, number-formatting and minor inflection transcription differences were read against the intended script; no mathematical change identified. No subjective listening.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: Negative radial distance is a substantial prerequisite for a novice. The introductory statement gives no graph of the radial rhythm. Finite images and correct formulas cannot establish delight or understanding.
